content.text:
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* 10 uA reference and complementary input-pair tail mirrors
XNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=1 m=1
XNT ns IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 m=1
RBIA VDD pbias 60000
XNBP pbias IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=15 L=1 m=1
XPT ptail pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=2 m=1
* NMOS and PMOS differential pairs share a single-ended summing node
XNI_P x VINP ns VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=8 m=1
XNI_N nrefp VINN ns VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=8 m=1
XPLD nrefp nrefp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=75 L=3 m=1
XPLM x nrefp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=75 L=6 m=2
XPI_P x VINP ptail VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=70 L=2 m=1
XPI_N prefp VINN ptail VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=70 L=2 m=1
XNLD prefp prefp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=12 L=6 m=1
XNLM x prefp VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=12 L=6 m=1
* PMOS common-source output stage and NMOS bias sink
XPOUT VOUT x VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 m=1
XNSINK VOUT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=54 L=1 m=1
* Miller compensation with series nulling resistor
RZ x ncomp 10000
CCOMP ncomp VOUT 2.5p
RREF x VSS 10000000
.ends DUT
